login.text: Open the app address in your browser. Enter your username and password on the sign-in page, then click **Sign in**.
login.tip: Forgot your password? Use the reset link under the form or ask your administrator.

logout.text: Click your name or avatar at the top right, then choose **Log out**.

sidebar.text: Use the menu on the left to switch between modules. Click a module name to open it. Groups with an arrow expand to show more pages.

search-box.text: Type part of a name or number in the **Search** box above the table. The list narrows as you type. Clear the box to see everything again.

filters.text: Click **Filter** above the table, choose the values you want, then click **Apply**. Click **Reset** to remove all filters.

pagination.text: Use the page numbers or the arrows at the bottom of the table to move between pages. The page-size box changes how many rows are shown.

sort.text: Click a column heading to sort by it. Click it again to reverse the order.

export-menu.text: Click **Export** above the table and choose a format such as Excel or PDF. The file downloads to your computer.

delete-confirm.text: Click the delete icon on the row. A confirmation box appears. Read it, then click **Delete** to confirm or **Cancel** to keep the record.
delete-confirm.tip: Deleted records usually cannot be restored.

profile-menu.text: Click your name or avatar at the top right to open account options such as profile, password and log out.
